title: Retro gaps found in real use are closed: none-gates, related lists, overlapping drafts, ticket rejection

requirements.text: a gate starting none: counts as ungated in retros and clusters, and genlock cause ID --clear FIELD empties a field
--related accepts a space- or comma-separated list of ticket ids
retro drafts no ticket for a flagged cluster whose bugs are a subset of another flagged cluster, and none for a cluster an existing ticket claims with meta retro.cluster
retro drafts are not linked to the goal, so goal progress counts are unchanged by a retro
genlock reject T-ID --user-said abandons a proposed ticket with the user's words, and genlock accept T-ID --user-said links it to its goal

fields.symptom: nightmaremode backfill of 39 bugs: none-gate hid a gap (T-Q85C4), --related 'T-A T-B' refused, 14 overlapping drafts for 39 bugs, drafts inflated goal count, no way to reject a draft
fields.root_cause: the retro was designed and tested against a 6-bug synthetic goal, so inputs that only appear at real scale (subset clusters, prose 'none' values, batch ids, a user reviewing many proposals) were never exercised
whys: gaps showed only in real use
tests built their own tidy fixture
no real goal had bug records yet when it shipped
fields.corrective: none-gate treated as ungated; --clear FIELD; --related splits lists; drafts skip subset and claimed clusters and stay off the goal; accept/reject for drafts
fields.preventive: tests/bugs.mjs now covers each real-use case, including subset, claimed and rejected clusters
fields.gate: npm test, the suite the app build and every commit here run

evidence: tests/bugs.mjs 13: gate 'none: run by hand' -> done refuses '--gate is not set'; cause --clear gate removes it; then gate set and done exits 0
tests/bugs.mjs 15: generator(3) + walls subset(2) + data-model claimed by meta retro.cluster -> exactly 1 proposed draft (missing-generator-rule); claiming ticket listed as existing
tests/bugs.mjs 15: houses goal progress.total identical before and after retro

tests/bugs.mjs 15: reject without --user-said exit 1, on a non-draft exit 1; accept links draft to goal (status draft); rejected race draft -> abandoned, and a third retro leaves 2 retro-tagged tickets

answers.observed: every fix read from tests/bugs.mjs 13-15 output
answers.cause: root cause is my reading of why the gaps escaped, not measured
answers.absence: nightmaremode's existing 14 drafts are still linked to its goal; the fix applies to new drafts only
answers.assumption: a cluster inside a larger one is the same cause; two causes can share bugs and this would hide the smaller
answers.falsify: a subset cluster whose fix differs from the larger cluster's
